$comment: The repository settings and the ruleset on main that make GitHub's merge queue the landing (kb/Work PB3024; DESIGN-test-build-ci.md §3.17.6). Applied ONLY on the owner's explicit go by `python scripts/orchestrator/ruleset.py apply --owner-go "<the go>"`, which also deletes the classic branch protection; `ruleset.py check` compares the live state with this file. Keys starting with `$` are notes, never sent.
$repository: allow_auto_merge: enqueue.py queues a PR whose checks are still running. merge_commit_message PR_BODY: `git log --first-parent main` reads the landing's forensic message on its merge commit. merge_commit_title stays MERGE_MESSAGE ('Merge pull request #N from …'), never PR_TITLE: a merge commit subjected `Train <label>:` would be read by prune_worktrees.py's train_heads as the train's last commit, and its first-parent walk would leave the train's Train-Cluster commits behind.

ruleset.name: main: merge queue
ruleset.$bypass_actors: Empty: enforced for administrators, as the classic protection's enforce_admins was (every push is made with the owner's credentials).

rules.$parameters: 0 approvals: the review is the wave's reviewer step (kb/Work PB3027), not a GitHub approval.

Merge method MERGE (a merge commit): the branch's commits stay ancestors of main, so prune_worktrees.py's landed test, carried() and git cherry keep working offline; squash was rejected on the operator's review 2026-10-11 12:16.
ci-gate, the terminal job of .github/workflows/build-and-test.yml, reported by GitHub Actions (integration 15368, as the classic protection named it).
